items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain garments with no prints, high detail. Palette: white, warm cream, sage green, white oak, natural daylight. A small British bathroom used to dry laundry: a white folding clothes airer standing on the tiled floor with plain towels and t-shirts hung neatly with gaps between them, the sash window above the bath opened slightly at the top, a white extractor fan on the wall, the bathroom door closed. The airer stands away from the radiator. Soft daylight, calm and fresh.
